figure_1: Figure 2. a) Temperature-dependent dielectric permittivity curves at 10 3 Hz upon cooling for di/uniFB00erent ceramics at x = 0, 0.25%, 0.5%, 1%, 2%. b) The impedance and phase angle of the BST-0Mn, BST-0.5%Mn, and BST-1%Mn ceramics near the fundamental resonance frequency of the planar vibration mode. c) Electric field-induced strain curves of BST-0Mn, BST-0.5%Mn, BST-1%Mn, Sm-PMN-29PT, PZT5H, PZT8 ceramics. d) Qm , d 33, and ɛ r of BST-0Mn, BST-0.5%Mn, and BST-1%Mn ceramics.
figure_2: Figure 3. a) Polarization-electric field ( P -E ) hysteresis loops measured at 2 kV cm -1 and b) strain-electric field ( S -E ) curves measured at 50 kV cm -1 of BST-0Mn, BST-0.25%Mn, BST-0.5%Mn and BST-1%Mn ceramics. Measurements were conducted at room temperature (21 ° C) at a frequency of 10 Hz. c) The corresponding maximum polarization P m, remanent polarization P r , and internal bias field E i as a function of Mn content. d) The maximum strain S m and the corresponding hysteresis as a function of Mn content, where hysteresis is calculated by Δ S / S m.
